title: HB410 (2025 Regular): AN ACT relating to prohibiting the possession and transfer of assault weapons and large capacity ammunition feeding devices.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Introduced, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/25RS/hb410/orig_bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 3108481))
provenance.note: Introduced print (25 RS BR 1050); no passage vote. The "assault weapon" definition (Section 1(1), long feature list) and Section 4 (KRS 237.104 conforming) not quoted for length.

operative_text:
Section 1 (KRS 527.010): (7) (a) "Large capacity ammunition feeding device" means a magazine, belt, drum, feed strip, or similar device that has a capacity of or that can be readily restored or converted to accept more than ten (10) rounds of ammunition.
Section 2 (new section of KRS Chapter 527): (1) Except as provided in subsection (3) of this section, a person is guilty of possession or transfer of a large capacity ammunition feeding device when he or she knowingly: (a) Possesses a large capacity ammunition feeding device; or (b) Transfers a large capacity ammunition feeding device to another person through any means. (2) Possession or transfer of a large capacity ammunition feeding device is a Class A misdemeanor. (3) This section shall not apply to: (a) A person who is a: 1. Member of the Armed Forces of the United States, a reserve component of the Armed Forces of the United States, or the National Guard; or 2. Law enforcement officer as defined in KRS 15.310; or (b) Any large capacity ammunition feeding device lawfully possessed prior to the effective date of this Act.
Section 3 (new section of KRS Chapter 527): (1) Except as provided in subsection (3) of this section, a person is guilty of possession or transfer of an assault weapon when he or she knowingly: (a) Possesses an assault weapon; or (b) Transfers an assault weapon to another person through any means. (2) Possession or transfer of an assault weapon is a Class A misdemeanor. (3) This section shall not apply to: (a) A person who is a: 1. Member of the Armed Forces of the United States, a reserve component of the Armed Forces of the United States, or the National Guard; or 2. Law enforcement officer as defined in KRS 15.310; or (b) Any assault weapon lawfully possessed prior to the effective date of this Act.
